biotools.summary: Triplicat analyses three common wet-lab assays in the web browser, without installation or account. Enzyme kinetics: Michaelis-Menten fit by nonlinear least squares on all replicates, with standard errors, 95 % confidence intervals and an R script that reproduces the fit. Bradford: linear or quadratic standard curve, sample concentrations with dilution factor. Thermal shift (DSF): Tm per well from the first derivative or a Boltzmann fit, delta Tm against a reference with 95 % CI (Welch test), plate layout editor, combinations of substances and several plates. Reads pasted tables, CSV and .xlsx, and long-format qPCR instrument exports. Exports figures (SVG, PNG) and results (CSV). Methods were checked against SciPy and R. All calculations run locally; no data leaves the user's device.
